english.quote: IELTS 6.5 overall, with no subskill below 6.5 TOEFL iBT 90 overall, with no subskill below 22
english.notes: Programme-specific (2027 entry). Also 'TOEFL iBT (1-6 scale) 4.5 overall, with at least 4.5 in all subskills'; IGCSE English as a Second Language grade 8. Test report must be valid on the course start date.

gpa.notes: No GPA. Typical offers: A-level A*AA including A* in Mathematics and a science; IB 37 points with 7,6,6 at HL (course page). Not a GPA scale.

deadline.quote: For 2027 entry, the closing date for receipt of applications to be given equal consideration is 13 January 2027 at 6pm (GMT).

The international application page still shows the 2026 cycle ('final deadline for international student applications is 30 June 2026 ... equal consideration deadline on 14 January 2026') (https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/international/admissions/undergraduate-application-process/).

tuition.quote: Tuition fees for international students will be £39,700 per annum.

scholarship_exists.quote: For 2027 entry, we have more than 350 partial merit-based scholarships open to both undergraduate and master's students.
scholarship_exists.notes: Partial, merit-based, competitive; country-restricted (applicant must live in one of the listed countries); application form emailed to offer-holders. Amount differs by region (country profiles); not a full ride.

scholarship_international.quote: We're proud to offer awards totalling more than £6 million to international students starting their studies in September 2027.
